instruction: Launch Chrome and go to the page where you can manage and configure your installed extensions.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome's extensions page (chrome://extensions/). Uses existing evaluator functions - is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric and active_url_from_accessTree getter. No new functions needed. Similar difficulty to original task (simple navigation).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the core requirement: navigating to Chrome's extensions management interface at chrome://extensions/
Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) properly extracts the active tab URL from the accessibility tree using Chrome's address bar element
Metric (is_expected_active_tab_approximate) appropriately strips query parameters and performs exact URL comparison
Data flow is correct: accessibility tree -> extract URL -> add goto_prefix (empty string) -> compare with expected URL
Expected value 'chrome://extensions/' is semantically correct for Chrome's extensions management page
Complete coverage: verifies the essential requirement of reaching the extensions page
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding URL normalization for trailing slashes (e.g., 'chrome://extensions' vs 'chrome://extensions/') to handle potential minor variations in how Chrome displays the URL, though this is unlikely to be an issue in practice
